candidate.analogy_boundary: An engineering analogue of adaptive variability around a stable rhythm; not a biological, medical, or clinical model.
candidate.definition: Fit the frozen 7, 30.4375, and 365.25 day ridge harmonic model on history available before the target. Compute seven-day historical innovations, estimate recent and long-run robust centers and scales, and apply a bounded recent-minus-long-run innovation correction whose gain decreases when recent variability exceeds long-run variability.

evaluation_contract.history_rule: At target date t, the candidate may use actual observations strictly before t only.
evaluation_contract.selection_rule: No candidate selection. This fixed candidate is appended as a retrospective exploratory comparison only.
